muse_spark_1.3/001: The strategy is take-then-safe-then-loony with exact endgame search. Take any box with 3 sides, preferring double takes and moves that keep the chain alive. If no take exists play a safe edge that creates no 3-sided box, minimizing the number of 2-sided boxes and total fill to avoid building chains. If every move gives boxes away, give the smallest greedy chain. When few edges remain the position is solved exactly by negamax with extra-turn rules `k+solve(next)` on take and `-solve(next)` otherwise, memoised on a 40-bit mask, which also finds correct sacrifices / double-crosses. Exact search is time limited with heuristic fallback, and a global transposition table is reused.
muse_spark_1.3/002: Strategy is control-based Dots-and-Boxes: take any 3-sided box, otherwise play a safe edge that never creates a 3-sided box, otherwise sacrifice the smallest chain. When few edges remain exact minimax with alpha-beta and chain-pruning finds optimal play including double-cross control. Move ordering, transposition table and time guard keep it under 1s with always-legal fallback.
muse_spark_1.3/003: The strategy is greedy capture with safe play and optimal endgame control. Take any completing box, otherwise avoid giving 3 sides, prefer moves that create few 2-sided boxes and keep many safe moves, sacrifice the smallest chain when forced, and solve exactly with memoised alpha-beta when few edges remain to handle double-cross.
muse_spark_1.3/004: The strategy is to never give away boxes for free, take everything that can be taken, and solve the endgame exactly. A box with 3 sides must be taken, preferring a move that closes 2 boxes. With no capture, a move that creates no 3-sided box for the opponent is safe and is always preferred. Safe moves are ranked to avoid creating 2-sided boxes. When no safe move exists the position is loony and the move that gives the opponent the smallest greedy chain is chosen. When few edges remain exhaustive negamax with extra-turn handling, bitboards, transposition table and alpha-beta finds the optimal future score difference, including double-dealing sacrifices.
muse_spark_1.3/005: The strategy is capture-first with chain control and exact endgame search. Take any box with 3 sides, otherwise play only safe edges that do not create a 3-sided box, preferring moves that create few 2-sided boxes and stay far from existing 2-sided boxes. If no safe move exists sacrifice the shortest chain by simulating greedy opponent take-all. When few edges remain use exact minimax DP over a 40-bit board with memoization to get optimal play including double-cross, otherwise fall back to the heuristic. A timeout guard guarantees a legal move.
